decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program is part of the firm's publicly communicated speed-of-delivery strategy and remained on the website in both years, so the visible commitment favours keeping it.

The seventy-two-hour program is costly to operate, but it has been promoted publicly as a differentiator alongside the other express offers, and any weak results can still be blamed on the temporary construction slump.
It has had a dedicated page in both years and sits at the centre of the announced express-delivery direction, which makes dropping it hard to justify.
The digital platform represents heavy sunk investment, is central to the firm's announced digitalization path, and keeps its own page, so management will persist with it.
The fire and smoke protection door was moved up to its own page in 2024, which signals growing commitment, and the certification costs already incurred argue for keeping it.
